=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Per `CLAUDE.md §20.A/B`, every PR that changes observable behaviour must add exactly one new fragment file `changelog.d/<issue-or-pr>-<slug>.md` with a unique path; "One fragment per PR. Never reuse another PR's filename — the unique path is the whole point." §20.A explicitly lists "thresholds" and "behaviour changes an operator or consumer repo would notice" as triggers for a fragment, and the conformance fix widens the pickup's per-wake API budget from "first `limit` targets" to "first 30 targets" — exactly that class of change.
  Expected change site: a new fragment file such as `changelog.d/4649-stuck-unbound-items.md` (or `changelog.d/4621-stuck-unbound-items.md`) carrying its own `<!-- changelog: fixed -->` marker, a 1–2-sentence headline, the 3–5-sentence lead explaining why `limit` stuck items used to starve the pickup and how the 3× window closes the hole, a "The numbers that matter" table including the 30-target / 3× factor, and a "What this means for operators" paragraph.
  Evidence of absence: the PR's changed-file list contains only `changelog.d/4621-bind-claude-queue-payloads.md` (a one-cell edit of the fragment introduced in PR #4639) and no new `changelog.d/*.md` file. The PR description's "changelog fragment" wording (singular) confirms the intent was to amend the existing fragment rather than create a new one, which §20.B explicitly forbids — and even after the edit the existing fragment still describes PR #4639's headline / lead paragraph and only inherits the new 30-target cell, so the conformance fix has no standalone changelog entry of its own. Reusing the existing fragment file (and editing it) also retroactively rewrites the documented behaviour for PR #4639 once `scripts/assemble_changelog.py` folds fragments into `CHANGELOG.md` at release time, since the editor would assemble one merged entry from the mutated file rather than two distinct entries.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
